title: Hosted API: backpressure controls and idempotency fix to stop recurring 5xx waves
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Multiple customers reported recurring 5xx spikes and elevated request timeouts over the last 48 hours. Symptoms include short-lived waves of 502/504 and internal 5xx errors correlated with tenant traffic surges and retry amplification. This ticket tracks root-cause investigation, short-term mitigations, and the rollout of a permanent fix that adds request-level backpressure, stronger idempotency handling for retries, and connection-pool safeguards in the hosted API gateway and runtime client.
reproduction_steps: Simulate a tenant traffic surge: 200 concurrent clients sending 8 requests/sec each to /v1/generate with average prompt length 250 tokens.
Introduce transient model-side 500ms stall (simulate slow KV cache eviction) on 20% of requests.
Enable client-side automatic retries with exponential backoff disabled (0ms jitter) to replicate amplification.
Observe gateway logs, connection counts, and 5xx rates in the hosted-api per-tenant dashboard (dashboard: /dash/hosted-api/tenant-5xx-wave).
investigation_notes: 2025-02-11: Initial customer reports from AcmeHealth and OmniSearch showing repeated 502 bursts during peak hours (attach logs).
Trace correlation shows that 5xx spikes line up with downstream model container queue depth reaching >200 and TCP connection pool exhaustion on the runtime agent.
Retry amplification: many SDKs were configured without idempotency keys so gateway Retries retried the same request multiple times causing duplicate inflight requests on the runtime.
Observed misconfigured keepalive settings: idle connections closed prematurely, causing frequent reconnects under load and increasing CPU on agents.
KV cache eviction path intermittently delayed the response path (GC pauses in a minority of model hosts), amplifying tail latency and triggering gateway timeouts.
No single-point hardware failure; problem is emergent due to interaction between retry behavior, connection pooling, and absence of backpressure at the API gateway under tenant surges.
root_cause_summary: An interaction bug: when tenants experience sudden traffic spikes and the model side returns transient stalls, the absence of request backpressure at the gateway combined with non-idempotent retry behavior and aggressive client retries created request amplification. This overwhelmed connection pools and model host queues, producing waves of 5xx responses and timeouts.
temporary_mitigation: Deployed gateway rate-limiter patch with emergency per-tenant concurrency cap (cap=120 concurrent requests) and enabled 500ms minimum retry backoff at the gateway for all customers. Notified customer success and throttled the most heavily impacted tenants by policy for 2 hours.
permanent_fix_plan: Add request-level backpressure at gateway: a token-bucket + dynamic concurrency window per-tenant that shrinks under elevated tail-latency.
Require/support idempotency-key header in SDKs and enforce idempotency at gateway to prevent amplification for retryable operations.
Harden runtime agent connection pool: increase max connections, add exponential backoff on reconnect, fix premature keepalive timeouts.
Instrument KV cache eviction to avoid stop-the-world stalls: streaming eviction and bounded GC work in runtime images.
Add a middleware to detect retry storms (burst of retries from same tenant) and automatically apply progressive backoff/fallback to lighter-weight model variants.
Add operational alerts for queue_depth > 150 and connection_retries > 50/min per agent.
rollout_strategy: Stage 1 (canary): Deploy backpressure + idempotency enforcement to 5% of traffic on hosted-api region us-west-2 for 24h. Monitor 5xx rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, and retry counts.
Stage 2: If stable, expand to 30% and run through a synthetic surge test (see testing_plan).
Stage 3: Expand to 100% with a 10-minute progressive ramp; keep emergency cap knobs available for 48h post-rollout.
Rollback: restore previous gateway config and disable idempotency checks if any customer-visible regressions are detected; auto-notify SRE and PM on rollback.
testing_plan: Load test: reproduce surge scenarios in staging with tenant fidelity (token sizes, concurrency).
Chaos test: inject 500ms stalls into model hosts to validate backpressure reduces inflight requests instead of increasing them.
SDK compatibility test: validate idempotency header handling across python/js/Go SDKs; ensure server rejects malformed idempotency headers gracefully.
End-to-end test: verify customer requests with and without idempotency keys receive correct semantics and no duplicate billing events.
